value.rationale: A natural source question about persistent silent versus spiking activity calls for separating fixed resting points from stationary oscillations. The exact second threshold, valid at its degenerate endpoint for all memory lengths, is not the mean-field pitchfork κ=1. It supplies a useful structural classification of the complete delayed state map and a concrete test for interpretation of neural activity, not a parameter-tweaked textbook exercise.
